name: Meridian Mining UK Societas
summary: Meridian Mining S.E., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the acquisition, exploration, development, and mining activities in Brazil. The company explores for manganese, gold, and tin deposits. Its flagship project is the Espigão manganese project located in Rondônia. The company was formerly known as Ferrometals Holdings Coöperatief U.A. Meridian Mining S.E. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
